purpose: IP-01 schema lineage crosswalk: classify the legacy JPA persistence module against the canonical Media PostgreSQL migration history. This is a census, not a migration cutover or runtime admission.

canonical.schemaStyle: unqualified media_* tables in the canonical datasource
canonical.semantics: immutable artifact/job/attempt/outbox/transcript revision history with fencing, CAS and provenance; single authoritative writer
tablesObserved: media_* artifact/job/attempt/outbox/lease tables introduced by V009..V027

legacyJpa.schemaStyle: audio_video schema; JPA entities AudioFileEntity + TranscriptionEntity
legacyJpa.semantics: mutable rows with version BIGINT optimistic-lock column and deleted/deleted_at soft-delete; PENDING status fields; full-text search index on transcriptions.text
legacyJpa.disposition: LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY_CANDIDATE: not an independent canonical Media runtime schema. Dual-read/adapter reconciliation per IP-02..IP-07; never a second migration runner or second transcript writer against canonical state.
legacyJpa.collisions: none observed: table names and schema namespace are disjoint from canonical media_* tables

guards.noDuplicateMigrationRunner: canonical Flyway history is owned solely by providers/aws-postgresql db/media-runtime; the JPA V1 script must never be applied to the canonical datasource
guards.noJpaDdlAuto: JPA entities must not auto-create or auto-mutate canonical tables; ddl-auto is forbidden on the canonical datasource
guards.disjointNamespaces: canonical migrations must not create audio_video schema objects; the JPA script must not create media_* tables
